candidate_source_format_audit.A_source_body_rule: src/retrieval/evidence.py: Source.content_for_prompt prefers highlights, otherwise text
candidate_source_format_audit.both_retain: Title and URL, plus publication date if supplied
candidate_source_format_audit.interpretation: Checked-in formatters produce different source bodies for these candidate packets. This is a competing confound to resolution-date omission; it is not proof of exact historical prompts or of causal impact.
candidate_source_format_audit.scope: The matching shared-cache candidate subset only

gap_decomposition.accounting_identity: Raw B-minus-A error count = strict-matched error difference + unmatched-row error difference; this identity is asserted in code

method.cache_limitation: Available shared candidate packet does not prove historical calls used the same evidence bytes; no immutable run-to-packet binding exists in these CSVs
method.cache_pairing: Same shared row_uid and expected packet filename; normalized ID/text/criteria match for every row; labels checked separately
method.confidence: Reported probability of own selected decision being correct; not probability of YES
method.data: Saved final architecture CSV predictions; independent offline recomputation, no model reruns
method.float_serialization: Round to 12 decimal places; no runtime timestamps
method.ground_truth: Each saved CSV's own ground_truth; strict paired comparisons require matching labels
limitations: Raw A/B gap is an arithmetic difference across nonidentical row content and labels, not a paired causal effect
Strict matching controls saved contract content and label, not prompts, retrieval or execution state
The cached subset is selected by artifact availability and is not a representative random sample
Confidence scales and tie concentration differ; these observations alone do not prove no possible benefit from averaging
Evidence absence causing false NO and missing resolution date causing the A/B gap remain untested mechanisms
Category counts do not establish causes; any assertion about unobserved crypto prices needs packet-level review
method.model_columns: gpt4o/deepseek/llama are historical CSV column names, not independently verified invocation logs
method.normalization: Replace literal backslash-n with spaces and collapse whitespace; label case uppercased for metrics
method.p_values: Exact two-sided McNemar/binomial; descriptive row-wise calculation, not corrected for repeated event/series clustering or post-hoc selection
method.selection: Retrospective same-sample ranking of A unanimous rows at the saved mean-confidence rule's coverage; not a held-out calibration experiment
method.strict_pairing: Normalized question_id, question_text, resolution_criteria, ground_truth plus within-key occurrence order
method.ties: Default descending exact-decimal score, original CSV row order; report alternate UID order, best/worst attainable boundary choices and uniform-random expected error count
